title: Two 8 Bit DDR3L
content:
Hello Sir/Ma’am,

I am planning to interface two 8-bit DDR3L memory devices with the STM32MP257FAK3. Kindly confirm whether this configuration is supported by the STM32MP257FAK3.

If supported, I would appreciate your guidance on the recommended implementation approach for this configuration.

Thank you for your assistance.

Regards,

Shubham Kawadkar
categoryName: STM32 MPUs Products and hardware related

scraped_replies.html:
Hello ​@shubham kawadkar ,
Please take a look at this MP2 DDR documentation, you will get all the information about supported DDR and configurations for the STM32MP2 family: https://www.st.com/resource/en/application_note/an5723-guidelines-for-ddr-configuration-on-stm32mp2-mpus-stmicroelectronics.pdf

Kind regards,
Erwan.
